universe: 13 ETFs: XLB XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLU XLV XLY XLRE XLC EFA EEM + T-bill basket (BIL SHV SGOV USFR)

params.formula: mean of the cross-sectional percentile ranks (average rank for ties, (rank-1)/(n-1), n = eligible count) of the two momenta

params.estimator: sample covariance of held names, evaluated at the actual weights

eligibility: an ETF is eligible only after max(273, long+1, abs_lookback+1, sma) bars of its own history
selection: 1) rank eligible ETFs by score (desc). 2) keep K = incumbents (names held at the previous snapshot) with rank <= 8 AND passing ABS_FILTER. 3) fill to 6 selected names with the best-ranked non-kept names (rank order). 4) held = selected names that pass ABS_FILTER; a selected name failing it leaves its slot to T-bills.
sizing: w_i = min(0.114, n_held x 0.114 x (1/sigma_i) / sum_held (1/sigma_j)) (6 slots x 11.4% = 68.4% max; inverse vol only DE-weights high-vol names; excess NOT redistributed); sigma_sleeve = sqrt(w' S w) annualized on the actual weights; k = min(1, 0.12 / sigma_sleeve); final w_i x k; residual -> T-bill basket -> cash.
entry_rule: Weekly snapshot at the close of the last session of each ISO week; book target = mean of the last 4 snapshots (ramp-in from cash); trade at the next session's open.
exit_rule: No discretionary exits; positions move only to the tranched book target (band 1.5%), via the drift guard, or to zero.
neighbourhood_rule: one parameter at a time, +/-25% (rounded to whole sessions), all else at main
expected_est: CAGR 6-10%, vol 9-13%, Sharpe 0.5-0.8, MaxDD 12-22% — C1 may bind; if it fails, do not tune
known_biases: XLC lists 2018-06-19 (eligible ~2019-07); 13 names is a narrow cross-section.
Cash above T-bill basket capacity earns 0%.
pre_registration_note: Written BEFORE scripts/research/strategy_lab.py or scripts/backtest/allocators.py existed and before any backtest of this spec family was run on any data. Any edit after the first run voids the results; amendments must be appended to 'amendments' with date + reason and re-counted as trials.
prior_knowledge_disclosure: NOT a blind test. Specs were written knowing the 2016-2026 path (2018Q4, 2020 crash, 2022 inflation bear, Apr-2025), the passive-core-ew8 v1/v2 results (FAIL C1) and the literature in docs/research/STRATEGY_EVIDENCE_2026-10.md. This is a pre-registered CONFIRMATION test on in-sample history, not out-of-sample evidence.

data.dataset: dividend-adjusted (adjustment=all) SIP daily bars, data/research_cache/adj10y_sip/{SYM}.json + data/research_cache/adj10y_sip_ext/{SYM}.json (DBMF, KMLM, CTA, SHV, SGOV, USFR) — gitignored; MANIFEST.json + QUALITY.md in each dir
data.eval_start: 2017-06-01 (session open; index 355 — every registered variant incl. +25% lookbacks is fully warmed up)
data.listing_rule: A symbol is unavailable (cannot be targeted) before its first bar. No backfill, no proxy splicing.
data.missing_bar_rule: No missing sessions in QUALITY.md; if a symbol has no bar on a session it is not tradable that session and is valued at its last close.

signal_bar: close of session t (signal functions receive only closes[0..t])
friction_source: scripts/backtest/friction.py load_friction('<portfolio>') => (5 bps cost, 5 bps slippage) per side = 10 bps per side on traded notional (repo floor).

friction_stress.note: 20 bps per side all-in (10 cost + 10 slippage). Counted as a separate trial.

tbill_basket.rule: LEAD DECISION 2026-10-23 (not a cap change): the defensive asset is a T-bill basket filled in priority order BIL, SHV, SGOV, USFR, each <= 11.4%. Anything above basket capacity is uninvested broker cash earning 0%. An ETF that has not listed yet (SGOV before 2020-05-28) is simply unavailable — no backfill.

caps.hard_cap_reference: config/risk_limits.json max single ETF 12% (NOT modified). 11.4% = 12% x 0.95 drift headroom.
caps.drift_guard: If any weight > 12.0% at a session close, it is trimmed to min(book target, 11.4%) at the next open (counts against the 12-order limit). Any position above 11.4% at a rebalance is traded regardless of the band.
caps.leverage: none: sum of weights <= 100%; buys are scaled down pro rata if cash would go negative after costs

execution.no_trade_band: per-strategy (see sizing). |target - current| < band (fraction of equity, valued at the trade open) => no trade, except (a) target == 0 and current > 0 => sell to zero, (b) current > 11.4% => trade to target.
execution.order_limit: max 12 orders per session (config/risk_limits.json max trades/day). Sells first, then buys by |delta w| descending; the rest is queued and re-evaluated against the same book target (with band) at the next session's open.

benchmark: SPY buy & hold (dividend-adjusted), 100% invested at the 2017-06-01 open with the same 10 bps entry friction

metrics.sharpe_definition: annualized (x sqrt 252) Sharpe of daily returns IN EXCESS of BIL's daily total return (scripts/backtest/metrics.sharpe_ratio on excess returns, rf=0). The rf=0 raw Sharpe is also reported but is NOT the criterion metric.
metrics.dsr: Deflated Sharpe (Bailey & Lopez de Prado; same null as scripts/backtest/metrics.deflated_sharpe_ratio): PSR of this candidate's per-period excess Sharpe vs SR0 = sqrt(var(all lab trial per-period Sharpes)) x ((1-gamma) Z(1-1/N) + gamma Z(1-1/(N e))), N = honest lab trial count, with the candidate's own skew/kurtosis.
metrics.calmar: scripts/backtest/metrics.calmar_ratio (CAGR / max drawdown) on the daily close equity curve.
metrics.calendar_year_return: last close of prior year -> last close of year
metrics.cpcv: scripts/backtest/cpcv.combinatorial_splits(n_obs, n_groups=6, n_test_groups=2, label_horizon=0, embargo_pct=0.01) over daily excess returns; distribution of test-set annualized Sharpe (no fitting occurs, so this is a path-stability diagnostic)
metrics.turnover: one-way turnover per year = sum |traded notional| / equity at trade / 2, annualized
metrics.risk_limit_replay: flags: any close-to-close daily return <= -4% (daily loss halt), drawdown from peak >= 18% (kill switch), any rolling 5-session return <= -8% (weekly halt). Informational, the backtest does not halt.

acceptance.scope: Evaluated on the eval span, net of base friction. A candidate PASSES only if ALL of C1..C6 pass.

C1_max_drawdown.metric: max drawdown of daily close equity

C2_calmar_vs_spy.threshold: SPY Calmar on the same span

C3_sharpe_and_dsr.metric: excess Sharpe and DSR at honest N

C5_neighbourhood.metric: |Sharpe(variant) - Sharpe(main)| for every registered neighbourhood variant

C6_cost_stress.metric: excess Sharpe at 20 bps per side

not_criteria: beating SPY CAGR or Sharpe on 2017-2026
acceptance.promotion: PASS => eligible for >= 90 days of PAPER forward test only (docs/LIVE_READINESS.md). FAIL => record, do not tune.

trial_plan.prior_related_families: passive-core-ew8 v1+v2 (2 trials, same ETF-allocation family, data/passive_core_validation*.json). DSR is reported at N=38 (criterion) and N=40 (incl. passive-core) for transparency. Unrelated ledgers noted but not pooled: data/trial_ledger.json (60 P1 self-learning knob trials), data/p2_scorecard.json (34 P2 trials), momentum_selector research.
trial_plan.rule: Every run in this list is executed exactly once with the registered parameters. Any additional run increments N and must be appended here before it is run.

registered_combinations.construction: Separate $100K books, equal initial capital, NO cross-book rebalancing (each book is a separate Alpaca account): combined equity = sum of the books' equity curves. Each combo is a trial; its 20 bps stress (blend of the components' stress curves) is a trial.
registered_combinations.acceptance: Same C1..C6. C5 for a combo: each component neighbourhood variant substituted for its component (others at main) must keep |dSharpe| < 0.25 (derived blends, no new runs).
